task_completion.description: The agent successfully launched the Memorize activity.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Memorize activity interface is visible, showing the game creation or play area.

task_completion.description: The agent entered the multiplication expressions (6x1 through 6x8) and their corresponding products into the card creation fields.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the agent typing '6x1' and '6' (and subsequent pairs up to 6x8) into the text input fields for card pairs.

task_completion.description: The game contains exactly 8 pairs of cards.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The card list or the game board shows 8 distinct pairs have been created/added to the set.

task_completion.description: The agent renamed the activity/game to '6 Times Table Game' in the activity's title bar or metadata field.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text '6 Times Table Game' is visible in the top activity title entry field.

task_completion.description: The agent saved the game to the Sugar Journal.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent clicks the 'Keep' (save) icon, or the Journal view is shown with an entry titled '6 Times Table Game' created at the current time.

integrity.description: The agent used the Memorize GUI to create the game rather than manipulating files via the terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows mouse clicks and text entry within the Memorize activity interface, not commands in the Terminal activity.

integrity.description: The agent manually entered the pairs rather than using a script or bulk import (if available).
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the agent interacting with the input fields for each of the 8 pairs.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual Sugar Memorize activity elements.
integrity.visual_evidence: The cursor is seen interacting with the specific Sugar OS UI elements (e.g., the 'Create' tab, text boxes, and the activity toolbar).

privileged_info_for_vlm: The game must contain exactly 8 pairs: (6x1, 6), (6x2, 12), (6x3, 18), (6x4, 24), (6x5, 30), (6x6, 36), (6x7, 42), and (6x8, 48). The required title for the Journal entry is '6 Times Table Game'.
